# JSON and JSONL schemas

The schema files are the normative machine-readable definitions. Examples are
validation fixtures, not substitutes for the schemas. Case and RunProfile use
their public YAML document contracts; see [Project, Case, and Profile](documents.md).

| Product | Schema | Example | Required top-level fields |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trajecta machine configuration | [M5_CONFIG.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_CONFIG.schema.json) | [M5_CONFIG.example.toml](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_CONFIG.example.toml) | `schema_version`, `default_reader_backend`, `daemon`, `resources`, `monitoring`, `profile_templates` |
| Trajecta project orchestration index | [M5_PROJECT_INDEX.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_PROJECT_INDEX.schema.json) | [M5_PROJECT_INDEX.example.yaml](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_PROJECT_INDEX.example.yaml) | `schema_version`, `name`, `cases`, `profiles` |
| Trajecta deterministic data plan | [M5_DATA_PLAN.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_DATA_PLAN.schema.json) | [M5_DATA_PLAN.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_DATA_PLAN.example.json) | `schema_version`, `project_sha256`, `requirements` |
| Trajecta single-result CLI envelope | [M5_CLI_OUTPUT.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_CLI_OUTPUT.schema.json) | [M5_CLI_OUTPUT.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_CLI_OUTPUT.example.json) | `schema_version`, `command`, `ok`, `data`, `diagnostics` |
| Trajecta JSONL stream item | [M5_CLI_STREAM_ITEM.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_CLI_STREAM_ITEM.schema.json) | [M5_CLI_STREAM_ITEM.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_CLI_STREAM_ITEM.example.json) | `schema_version`, `command`, `sequence`, `kind` |
| Trajecta durable job-attempt record | [M5_JOB_RECORD.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_JOB_RECORD.schema.json) | [M5_JOB_RECORD.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_JOB_RECORD.example.json) | `schema_version`, `job_series_id`, `run_id`, `attempt`, `state`, `input`, `resources`, `created_at` |
| Trajecta persistent job event | [M5_JOB_EVENT.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_JOB_EVENT.schema.json) | [M5_JOB_EVENT.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_JOB_EVENT.example.json) | `schema_version`, `sequence`, `emitted_at`, `job_series_id`, `run_id`, `attempt`, `kind`, `state` |
| Trajecta dry-run prune plan | [M5_PRUNE_PLAN.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_PRUNE_PLAN.schema.json) | [M5_PRUNE_PLAN.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_PRUNE_PLAN.example.json) | `schema_version`, `mode`, `delete_enabled`, `candidates` |
| Trajecta result inspection | [M5_RESULT_INSPECTION.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_RESULT_INSPECTION.schema.json) | [M5_RESULT_INSPECTION.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_RESULT_INSPECTION.example.json) | `schema_version`, `result_path`, `identity`, `lifecycle`, `software`, `inputs`, `execution`, `numerical`, `particles`, `quality`, `mass_ledger`, `artifacts`, `catalog` |
| Trajecta trajectory record | [M5_TRAJECTORY_RECORD.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_TRAJECTORY_RECORD.schema.json) | [M5_TRAJECTORY_RECORD.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_TRAJECTORY_RECORD.example.json) | — |
| Trajecta trajectory stream header | [M5_TRAJECTORY_STREAM.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_TRAJECTORY_STREAM.schema.json) | [M5_TRAJECTORY_STREAM.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_TRAJECTORY_STREAM.example.json) | `schema_version`, `job_series_id`, `run_id`, `attempt`, `status`, `run_success`, `selection` |
| Trajecta M4 run manifest | [M4_RUN_MANIFEST.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M4_RUN_MANIFEST.schema.json) | — | `schema_version`, `job_series_id`, `attempt`, `run_id`, `case_name`, `status`, `started_at`, `software`, `inputs`, `execution`, `numerical`, `geometries`, `effective_outputs`, `sqlite`, `terminations`, `mass_ledger` |
| Trajecta M4 particle-state provenance bundle | [M4_PROVENANCE_BUNDLE.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M4_PROVENANCE_BUNDLE.schema.json) | — | `schema_version`, `run_id`, `sqlite`, `record_hash_algorithm`, `records`, `field_sets`, `samples` |
| Trajecta product build manifest | [M5_BUILD_MANIFEST.schema.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_BUILD_MANIFEST.schema.json) | [M5_BUILD_MANIFEST.example.json](https://github.com/origin652/trajecta/blob/main/trajecta/testdata/M5_BUILD_MANIFEST.example.json) | `schema_version`, `product`, `version`, `platform`, `source`, `build`, `archive`, `binary`, `sbom`, `license_inventory`, `native_components`, `payload` |

Schema versions identify disk and stream formats independently of the software
version. M5.1 does not introduce a new schema version.
